parties:
Mohammad Anwarul Islam and others
Vs.
Ministry of Education and others
full_judgment: 5. The petitioners filed a supplementary affidavit reiterating their earlier stand and submitted that if the said College was an Intermediate level College, then only one Lecturer in Bengali, one Lecturer in English, one Lecturer in Political Science, one Lecturer in History, one Lecturer in Philosophy and one Lecturer in Geography would serve in the College and they would get the MPO. But at present 3 Lecturers in Bengali, 2 Lecturers in English, 2 Lecturers in Political Science, 2 Lecturers in Philosophy, 2 Lecturers in Geography are serving in the College and they are getting the government portion of the salary (MPO). The numbers of Lecturers now serving in the College in each subject prove that the Nachole College is a Decree College.
